title: Poverty and Inequality Platform: every survey-year estimate of poverty and inequality, by economy
provider: The World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform API v1

povline.description: The poverty line, 2021 PPP dollars a day (the international line is $3.00 since June 2025)

international.description: The international poverty line of $3.00 a day

format: JSON, a row for each economy, reporting year and level (national, urban, rural): headcount, poverty gap, mean, median, Gini, decile shares, population.
coverage: About 172 economies; surveys from 1963 to the latest update.
licence: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank terms of use for datasets)
citation: World Bank (2026), Poverty and Inequality Platform, https://pip.worldbank.org.
